high_level_description: The image features a man standing in front of multiple Indian flags. He is dressed in traditional Indian attire, which includes a white kurta with a blue checkered vest over it. Around his neck, he wears a colorful scarf adorned with various patterns, including fish and floral designs. The man has a beard and is wearing glasses. His right hand is raised, pointing upwards with his index finger extended. The background consists of several Indian flags, each featuring the Ashoka Chakra in the center, a symbol commonly associated with India.
